definitions.explanation: Supplies stored in advance for emergencies or future use, such as food, water, or fuel.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}に{備|そな}えて{食料|しょくりょう}を{備蓄|びちく}している。
examples.english: We stockpile food in preparation for disasters.

examples.japanese: {石油|せきゆ}{備蓄|びちく}は{国|くに}の{安全保障|あんぜんほしょう}に{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Oil reserves are important for national security.

examples.japanese: {各家庭|かくかてい}で3{日分|みっかぶん}の{水|みず}を{備蓄|びちく}しましょう。
examples.english: Each household should stockpile three days' worth of water.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{備|び} (prepare, equip) + {蓄|ちく} (store, accumulate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{食料|しょくりょう}{備蓄|びちく} - food stockpile
・{石油|せきゆ}{備蓄|びちく} - oil reserves
・{備蓄|びちく}{品|ひん} - stockpiled goods
・{備蓄|びちく}{倉庫|そうこ} - stockpile warehouse
・{緊急|きんきゅう}{備蓄|びちく} - emergency reserves

DISASTER PREPAREDNESS:
In Japan, households are encouraged to stockpile:
・{水|みず} - water (3 liters per person per day)
・{非常食|ひじょうしょく} - emergency food
・{懐中電灯|かいちゅうでんとう} - flashlight
・{乾電池|かんでんち} - batteries
・{救急|きゅうきゅう}セット - first aid kit

RELATED WORDS:
・{貯蔵|ちょぞう} - storage, preservation
・{蓄|たくわ}え - reserves, savings
・{物資|ぶっし} - supplies, goods
